references.context: Before the Double Jackpot, hit the captive ball from control.
references.label: Captive ball
references.description: The captive ball is beside the KEE targets on the left-middle playfield.

references.context: Shoot the left ramp for the Jackpot.
references.label: Left ramp Jackpot
references.description: The left ramp is in the upper-left area.

references.label: Electric Chair scoop
references.description: The Electric Chair scoop is in the upper-center-left area.

references.context: Hit the Tombstone to spell CRYPT.
references.label: Tombstone and Crypt
references.description: The Tombstone blocks the Crypt in the upper-center area.

references.context: On the first start, the center spinner can also start the multiball.
references.label: Center spinner
references.description: The center spinner is in the upper-center-right lane.

references.context: Then shoot the right ramp for the Double Jackpot.
references.label: Right ramp Double Jackpot and Frenzy
references.description: The right ramp is on the upper-right side.
